about_the_game:
Your royal treasury is empty. Your kingdom? A sad pile of dirt. But you have one thing going for you: a shiny gold nugget and an irresistible urge to click it.

Welcome to Clicker Kingdom, a cozy medieval idle game wrapped in gorgeous pixel art where your clicking obsession finally pays off.

TAP YOUR WAY TO GLORY Every click fills your coffers with precious gold. It's simple. It's satisfying. It's oddly therapeutic. Start with nothing but your finger and a dream of endless wealth.

BUILD YOUR MEDIEVAL EMPIRE Spend your hard-earned gold on buildings that generate passive income while you sleep, eat, or pretend to work. From humble farms to majestic castles, watch your kingdom transform from a muddy village into a glittering empire.

HIRE AN ARMY OF MINIONS Why click alone when you can hire peasants to do the dirty work? Recruit workers, upgrade their skills, and turn your kingdom into a gold-generating machine. They don't even ask for vacation days.

ASCEND TO GREATNESS Reached the ceiling? Smash through it. The Ascension system lets you reset your progress for powerful permanent upgrades. Each rebirth makes you stronger, richer, and closer to medieval world domination.

FEATURES:

  • Relaxing clicker gameplay with satisfying progression

  • Beautiful pixel art medieval aesthetic

  • Buildings and employees to unlock and upgrade

  • Ascension system with permanent upgrades

  • 50 achievements to chase

  • Idle income while you're away

  • Perfect for quick sessions or long binges

Whether you have five minutes or five hours, Clicker Kingdom rewards every tap, every upgrade, and every moment of gold-hoarding glory.

Your kingdom awaits. Time to click.

  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)

  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / ATI Radeon HD 7950
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible con DirectX
  • Additional Notes: A mouse and keyboard are recommended for the best gaming experience.

short_description: Click gold. Buy stuff. Become disgustingly rich. This cozy medieval clicker lets you build your kingdom one satisfying tap at a time. Hire peasants, construct buildings, and when you've hoarded enough gold... Ascend and do it all over again, but better. 50 achievements await, Your Majesty.
